title: 混合LSTM-图神经网络框架用于鲁棒的金融欺诈检测与对抗韧性
summary: 提出FraudShield AI混合框架，结合LSTM与手工图拓扑特征（PageRank、入度动态、自定义流量比），从孤立交易分析转向网络级取证。使用Focal Loss处理数据不平衡（0.13%欺诈率），动态阈值增强对低值smurfing攻击的韧性。在PaySim数据集上优于逻辑回归和XGBoost基线。
summary_en: Proposes FraudShield AI hybrid framework combining LSTM with hand-crafted graph topological features (PageRank, in-degree dynamics, custom flow ratio) to shift from isolated transaction analysis to network-level forensics. Uses Focal Loss for extreme imbalance (0.13% fraud rate) and dynamic thresholding against low-value smurfing. Outperforms LR and XGBoost on PaySim.
